class.name: InputActions
class.brief_description: A collection of [InputAction]s with lookup by action name.

method.name: add_action
method.description: Adds [param action] at the end of [member actions]. If an action with the same [member InputAction.action] is already in the list, it is replaced by [param action] in its place. Fails with an error if [param action] is [code]null[/code] or has no name.

method.name: get_action
method.description: Returns the action named [param action], or [code]null[/code] if the list has none. The returned action is the one in the list, not a copy.

method.name: get_action_count
method.description: Returns the number of actions in the list.

method.name: get_action_names
method.description: Returns the names of all actions, in the order of [member actions].

method.name: has_action
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the list has an action named [param action].

method.name: remove_action
method.description: Removes the action named [param action]. Returns [code]true[/code] if an action was removed, [code]false[/code] if the list has none with that name.

members.member: The actions of the list. If several entries have the same name, the last one wins.
